faqs.question: What catering services does Qatind Restaurant provide?
faqs.answer: We provide catering solutions for educational institutions, corporate offices, industries, healthcare environments, parties and outdoor events.

faqs.question: Do you provide institutional catering?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide catering solutions for schools, colleges and universities, subject to specific requirements.

faqs.question: Are there vegetarian options?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! About 40% of our menu is vegetarian with delicious options.

faqs.question: Do you provide corporate catering?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer food and catering solutions suitable for corporate offices and industrial environments.

faqs.question: Do you offer bakery products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our bakery section includes premium and traditional plum cake options, including gift-wrapped options.

faqs.question: Can I request a customised menu?
faqs.answer: Menu customisation can be discussed based on your event, guest requirements and catering needs.

faqs.question: How can I contact Qatind Restaurant?
faqs.answer: You can contact our team through the enquiry form or the contact details provided on our website.
